Trap [Jyhad, V:TES, Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable before range is determined on the first round of combat. During
the press step, if any Methuselah has played a card earlier in the current
round or during the two previous rounds, the Trap automatically provides a
press to continue (either combatant can press to end).

this seems trivial but still i need to know.

trap is played and no other cards. does the combat last for 3 rounds or 4?

in other words, does trap count towards the "card played.." thing or not?

thanks for the help
